title: Herald of Scales' Dragon discount never applies to any real card because no card in the pool carries the Dragon tag (Harnessed Dragon ogn-234-298, Kadregrin the Infernal ogn-038-298, Elder Dragon, Fae Dragon etc. all have tags=[] / undefined in /api/cards, while their printed frames read 'UNIT · DEMACIA · DRAGON').
expected: Card data confirms it: /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/harnessed-dragon.ts:4-15 and kadregrin-the-infernal.ts:4-16 define no `tags` field; the set JSON (data/sets/ogn.json ~line 8457) has `"tags": []` for Harnessed Dragon; all-cards.ts:830 just copies `c.tags` with no name-based derivation. Runtime check via getCardRegistry() shows tags=undefined for ogn-234-298/ogn-038-298 and zero cards in the entire registry carrying a "Dragon" tag. The engine matcher at riftbound-engine/src/operations/static-cost-reduction.ts:813-816 requires playedTags to include the tag, so Herald of Scales' aura (herald-of-scales.ts:13) can never match any real card. Only the unit test (ogn-140-298.test.ts:16-17) uses synthetic tags:["Dragon"] cards.
observed: Harnessed Dragon charged full 8 (energy 20 -> 12). Kadregrin: playUnit not offered at 7 or 8 energy, only at 9. Engine static (cost-reduction target {controller:friendly, tag:'Dragon'}) parses fine and static-cost-reduction.ts matches on playedDef.tags, but card data supplies no non-champion tags, so the aura is inert.
